Sandbox helper prototypes for environment, descriptors, IDs, namespaces, limits, caps, Landlock, and seccomp.

# Purpose
This header declares private sandbox helper functions used to set up process isolation on Linux. The functions clear environment variables, verify the open file descriptor set, switch user and group IDs, write user namespace ID maps, deny new namespaces, change the root filesystem, set resource limits, read `cap_last_cap`, drop capabilities, apply Landlock rules, and install a seccomp-bpf filter. It also declares [`fd_sandbox_private_enter_no_seccomp`](<#fd_sandbox_private_enter_no_seccomp>), which enters the sandbox without the seccomp filter for test use. The file exposes only function prototypes and includes `fd_sandbox.h` for the shared sandbox types and declarations.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_sandbox_private_explicit_clear_environment_variables`
- `fd_sandbox_private_check_exact_file_descriptors`
- `fd_sandbox_private_switch_uid_gid`

- `fd_sandbox_private_deny_namespaces`
- `fd_sandbox_private_pivot_root`
- `fd_sandbox_private_set_rlimits`
- `fd_sandbox_private_read_cap_last_cap`
- `fd_sandbox_private_drop_caps`
- `fd_sandbox_private_landlock_restrict_self`
- `fd_sandbox_private_set_seccomp_filter`
- `fd_sandbox_private_enter_no_seccomp`
